## Description

Scatter simple trees (wood trunk + leaf canopy) on the surface.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Trees vary slightly in size (height 3-6 blocks)
- [ ] Trees don't spawn underwater or on stone
- [ ] Trees are breakable like any other blocks (trunk and leaves separately)
- [ ] Distribution feels natural, not gridded

## Notes for AI

* Tree = vertical wood column + small cube of leaf blocks on top
* Use a probability check (e.g., 1% per surface grass block) for placement
* Seed the placement so worlds are reproducible

## Definition of done

All acceptance criteria met, file runs without console errors.
